name: Sohva Remote
title: A little less to do.
summary: An evening in miniature. Try a mute with an owner, a scene that leaves standby alone, and the last minute before the television goes dark.
alt: An authored charcoal and brass drawing of a sofa, a phone and a television casting light into the room.
boundary: Authored room illustration. Interactive reductions of selected app rules; no television is connected.

name: Maintenance acceptance
title: The action may already have happened.
summary: A broken connection leaves a completed action in doubt. Look into the interruption, the receipts and the decision to try again.
alt: AI-generated illustration of two rugged radios and a relay enclosure; hardware details are illustrative.
boundary: AI-generated hardware illustration. The TNT room uses published, historical packet observations.

name: Data center
title: Where the power goes.
summary: Follow the electricity through a room, a shared Finnish grid and the heat that may reach a home. Open the assumptions behind each number.
alt: Illustrative data center room in the studio’s charcoal and brass palette.
boundary: Illustrative room. Published data and explicit scenario assumptions remain separately inspectable.

name: Field power
title: What stays on.
summary: When energy becomes scarce, recovery is a choice. Change the loads and inspect what the site can keep running.
alt: Captured Field power interface with a modelled site, generator, battery and load account.
boundary: Captured software study. Inspectable energy model and explicit scenario assumptions.

name: Maritime study
title: The crossing, held still.
summary: A crossing between Helsinki and Tallinn, seen from the water and the bridge. Light, weather and instruments belong to the same picture.
alt: Captured 3D study of MyStar on the Helsinki–Tallinn crossing.
boundary: Captured software study. Modelled geometry and conditions are not a navigational reference.

name: Coastal watch
title: The water between updates.
summary: Two stations can receive the same report and still hold different pictures. Follow an interruption, a late observation and the uncertainty between witnesses.
alt: Coastal watch plot showing vessel tracks against a detailed coastline.
boundary: Real coastline with synthetic tracks in this capture. Each room names its own recorded, live or authored evidence.

name: LiveConnect
title: The connection came back. Did the picture?
summary: A healthy connection can carry an old reading. Interrupt the stream and inspect the difference between reachability and freshness.
alt: Diagram separating a connection’s state from the age of its reading.
boundary: Authored connection study. Its events and evidence can be inspected.

name: Buggy
title: Where are we, according to whom?
summary: A camera, a route and a map do not automatically agree. Inspect the captured views and the limits of the comparison.
alt: Owner-captured camera view from the Buggy mapping study.
boundary: Owner captures. Calibration and ground-truth alignment are not established.

name: SkyStack
title: The thing you just tried.
summary: An earlier homepage exhibit: stamp geometry, replay and a question about what the renderer actually drew.
alt: Native footprint plot from the SkyStack renderer study.
boundary: Native footprint plot, not a game capture.

name: Ajo
title: An answer is missing. What now?
summary: An earlier homepage exhibit: a lost reply, a recovered result and one application at the receiver. Inspect the saved simulator record.
boundary: Saved simulator record. This exhibit opens on the homepage.
